LESSON: ISLAMIC RULES ON BUYING AND SELLING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.3: Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling
2. Practise Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling in the examples.
2. Explain Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling
2. Practise Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Islamic Rules on Buying and Selling

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
